correctness.rationale: Reconstructed each generating simplex as the convex hull of nondecreasing-prefix step corners and established the coordinate box [L,U] for the entire Minkowski sum with both antipodal corners attained. In any Euclidean box, ||x−(L+U)/2||²≤||U−L||²/4, equality only if each nonconstant coordinate is a box endpoint; the two antipodal feasible corners imply the radius and unique center. Positivity of all legs forces every summand’s step coordinate in a contact to be 0 or its full leg value, and overlaps force matching binary step choices along each connected interval union; each union of ℓ integer coordinates has exactly ℓ+1 admissible cuts. Antipodal step pairs require each component’s binary word constant, giving 2^(c−1) unordered pairs. The Kozlov squared-diameter binomial autocorrelation follows by Vandermonde with k=0,1 terms removed. Independently enumerated all shifted vertex-sum contact patterns and antipodal pairs in hundreds of small n,r,shift tuples; this is corroboration of the universal equality-case proof.

value.rationale: The exact enclosing sphere, its complete equality-case contact stratum, count of diametral pairs and sharp overlap-component transition are natural Euclidean metric invariants of a studied all-rank polytope family. The all-parameter contact classification is meaningful beyond known convex-hull/vertex enumerations; it is a structural metric fact rather than a gratuitous small numerical slice.

final_claim: For any strictly positive-leg shifted Minkowski sum of right-angle simplices, its coordinate minimum L and maximum U are attained, giving diameter ||U−L|| and unique minimum Euclidean circumball centered (L+U)/2; if overlapping coordinate supports split into c components of integer lengths ℓ_α, exactly ∏_α(ℓ_α+1) vertices contact that sphere and 2^(c−1) unordered diametral pairs occur, including the binomial-autocorrelation Kozlov specialization and a sharp two-summand support-disconnection transition.
limitations: Requires ordinary Euclidean coordinate metric, strictly positive legs and specified shifted right-angle simplex Minkowski sums.
